booking: Choose a route, dates, passenger count and flight, then enter passenger details and review the fare conditions before payment.
Can I change or cancel a booking?
Options depend on ticket rules, route, booking channel and timing. Check the fare conditions and manage the booking through its original seller.
What if I cannot find my confirmation?
Check the booking email and spam folder, then retrieve the itinerary through the booking channel or ask its support team.
How should I enter passenger names?
Use the name shown on the travel document. For unusual name formats or corrections, contact the airline before travel.
checkin: When can I check in online?
The pages reviewed say check-in opens 48 hours before departure. They give different closing cutoffs, so check the current trip instructions before relying on a deadline.
What do I need to check in?
Have the booking reference and passenger surname ready. International trips can also require passport details.
Will online check-in issue a boarding pass?
Domestic trips may receive a printable boarding card. Some international trips receive a confirmation slip for document checks at the airport.
What if I cannot retrieve my trip?
Check the booking reference and surname against the ticket. If the trip remains unavailable, use the airport counter and contact the booking provider.
baggage: How much baggage can I take?
Allowance depends on route, cabin, fare and loyalty status. Check the e-ticket or trip-specific baggage calculator.
What can I take in the cabin?
The guide lists a maximum size of 55 × 40 × 20 cm. Weight varies by cabin. Check the allowance for the selected itinerary.
How do I travel with special or restricted items?
Rules depend on the item and route. Review the restricted-items guidance before packing sports equipment, instruments, batteries or other unusual items.
What should I do about lost or damaged baggage?
Report it to airline staff at the airport and keep the baggage tag and travel documents for tracking or a claim.
reaccommodation: Eligibility depends on the ticket, booking contact details, operating airline, party size, disruption timing and replacement-seat availability.
The page describes eligible self-service rebooking as free. Confirm that the specific booking qualifies before accepting a new itinerary.
loyalty: How do I earn and use Maharaja Club points?
Eligible flights and partners can earn points. The programme also covers tiers, reward flights, upgrades and vouchers. Current terms define eligibility.
How do I manage my membership?
The membership guide covers registration, account access, profile updates, missing points and family pooling. Use account support for personal record changes.
notifications: Which journey notifications may I receive?
Updates can cover booking, check-in, baggage, gate changes, disruptions and post-travel feedback. Delivery depends on the contact details and available channels.
What if an agent made my booking?
Ask the agent to add your current email and phone number. If updates are missing, verify the contact details attached to the booking.
insurance: What does the travel insurance cover?
The product page describes possible protection for medical events, baggage issues and travel disruption. The purchased policy defines actual coverage and exclusions.
How do I check eligibility or make a claim?
Use the policy documents and insurer’s claim instructions. Eligibility and claim requirements depend on the policy and trip.
cargo: How do I book or track cargo?
Cargo uses separate booking, tracking and handling processes. Choose the relevant cargo service and shipment details.
Where do I ask about cargo claims or restricted goods?
Use cargo support for claims, refunds, dangerous goods, live animals and other shipment-specific requirements.
health: When may medical clearance be needed?
The guidance identifies recent illness or surgery, uncertain fitness to fly, oxygen and medical equipment as cases that may need advance review.
How do I request wheelchair assistance?
Request assistance in advance and submit any required medical information. Airline approval and arrangements depend on the traveler’s needs and itinerary.
children: What should I prepare when travelling with an infant?
Check age eligibility, travel documents, accompanying-adult rules and destination requirements for the itinerary.
Age limits and unaccompanied-minor service rules vary. Confirm eligibility and arrangements with the airline before booking.
pets: Can my pet travel in the cabin?
Acceptance depends on route, aircraft, animal type, carrier and combined weight, documents, and advance approval.
Requirements and charges vary by destination and transport method. Confirm the current airline and government rules for every flight sector.
payments: How do I request a refund?
Refund eligibility and amount depend on fare terms, route, timing and where the ticket was purchased. Start through the original booking channel.
What if a flight is cancelled or missed?
Refund or rebooking options depend on the cause, fare and timing. Review the disruption notice and ticket conditions before taking action.
integration: Does the Vistara integration page describe current rules?
It contains historical information about transferred bookings, loyalty accounts and vouchers. Some material refers to past transition dates and may be outdated.
How should I verify a current booking?
Use the current itinerary and applicable loyalty terms. Check the latest booking-specific information before acting on old transition guidance.
rail: It combines an air itinerary with an eligible rail segment. Check-in, seats and baggage may follow separate rail and airline processes.
Is Rail and Fly available now?
The reviewed source said the Deutsche Bahn service was temporarily suspended. Availability may change, so verify it during booking.
app: What can I do in the airline app?
The app information describes booking, trip management, check-in and other journey services. Available functions depend on the current app version.
What if a payment or booking in the app is unclear?
Check the booking status before trying again. Keep any reference details and contact the original booking channel if the result is uncertain.
account: How do I register or sign in?
The registered-customer section covers account enrollment, access, profile information and membership benefits. Follow the current verification steps.
What if I cannot access my account?
Use the account recovery or support process. Do not share passwords or one-time codes with anyone.
wifi: How do I know if my flight has Wi-Fi?
Availability varies by aircraft and route and can change. Check flight-specific information before departure.
How do I connect to onboard Wi-Fi?
Follow the onboard portal instructions, verify the booking details requested and choose an available plan. Plan terms and prices can change.
baggage-guidelines: How do I check my exact baggage allowance?
Allowance varies by itinerary, cabin and fare. Check the e-ticket or use the trip-specific baggage calculator.
What topics does the baggage guide cover?
It organizes cabin and checked baggage, restricted items, excess and special baggage, damaged or missing bags, tracking and airport-specific acceptance guidance.
customer-support: How do I contact customer support?
The help hub groups FAQs, care channels, global contact centres and a request form. Choose the channel that matches the issue and have booking details ready.
Where do I report lost property?
Use the lost-item contact process. Missing checked baggage follows the separate baggage reporting and tracking process.
flight-status-info: What details can I use to search flight status?
The status page supports searches by flight number, booking reference or route.
The official page describes a window from two days before through two days after today. The Veyra lookup uses local sample data, not live airline updates.
online-checkin-info: The page covers the check-in window, baggage drop, domestic boarding cards, international confirmation slips, codeshare limits and city check-in.
What should I do with an international confirmation slip?
Take it to the airport counter for document verification and collection of the boarding pass. A confirmation slip itself is not a boarding pass.
